## Summary
Describe the change, motivation, and any user impact.

## Testing
List commands executed locally or in CI and link to results.

## User/Support Feedback Referenced
Link issues, conversations, or feedback templates that informed this PR.

## Wise Tech Principle Reinforced
Identify which principle(s) this change strengthens and how.

## Simplicity & Maintainability Check
Explain how the solution stays lean, avoids unnecessary tooling, and remains easy to maintain.

## Resilience & Knowledge Capitalization Check
Detail how the change protects reliability and captures reusable knowledge (docs, playbooks, automation).
